description: This file provides utility functions for platform detection, download link generation, and device info retrieval within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Detects the current platform (OS) based on navigator properties and user agent.

methods.name: getDownloadLink
methods.description: Provides download links for different platforms based on the platform name.

methods.name: isMac
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is macOS or a Mac App Store app.

methods.name: isMacStoreApp
methods.description: Determines if the app is a Mac App Store version.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with app version, OS, browser, and optional extras.
